svg.title: WISTR coolant system sheet 1
svg.text: Three established process legs; proposed measurement and isolation locations shown in amber.
PER LEG: 4.620 m3/s; pump rise 286 kPa; 1.65 MW shaft; provisional 2 MW motor. Main line bore 1425 mm.
Main wall 25 mm; radial insulation hot 400 / return 350 mm (conditional estimates). Pump rise is not system design pressure.
FS-CS-001 | Rev A | 13 October 2026 | Preliminary - for discussion
Sheet 1 / 2 | Functional schematic; not to scale
